# The Grill

> A responsive React web app for The Grill, a family-owned Mediterranean restaurant in Chicago. Portfolio project demonstrating component architecture, routing, form validation, state management, accessibility, and testing.

## Pages
- Home: /
- Menu: /menu
- About: /about
- Order Online: /order
- Reservations: /reservations
- Login: /login

## Notes
This is a frontend-only demo project. Booking and ordering flows are simulated (no real backend/payment processing).
